notes.title: Update: Fixed issues with transitions
notes.notes:
A new update for PANORAMICAL is up with minor fixes for the launch version:

 Holding the Transition key after a scene no longer blocks the transition action
 The credits layout is no longer broken by different resolutions
 Taking a snapshot on the tutorial is only required for a little bit
